header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioners; nor intimation received.
body: Perusal of record reveals that the petitioner has challenged impugned order dated 08-03-2017, available at page No.15 of court file, in year 2024 without explaining the laches involved. In view of such a position, this petition being barred by limitation/ laches is hereby dismissed alongwith listed pending application.
